description_zh: 调用GetDataServiceFolder查询数据服务文件夹
name: GetDataServiceFolder

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] The tenant ID. To obtain the tenant ID, log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), go to the Data Studio page, click the current username in the upper-right corner, and choose Menu > User Info
parameters.help_zh: 该字段已废弃。租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en:
The workspace ID.

You can obtain this ID from the PageResult.ProjectList[].ProjectId parameter in the response of the ListProjects operation.

Before calling ListProjects to obtain the workspace ID, ensure that your account has the required DataWorks edition and the necessary permissions. The sample ID is for format demonstration only
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间的ID。

可通过 ListProjects 响应中的 PageResult.ProjectList[].ProjectId 获取。

通过 ListProjects 获取工作空间 ID 时，请先确认账号已开通该接口要求的 DataWorks 版本并具备相应权限；示例 ID 仅用于展示格式
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The folder ID.

You can obtain this ID from the FolderPagingResult.Folders[].FolderId parameter in the response of the ListDataServiceFolders operation
parameters.help_zh:
文件夹的ID。

可通过 ListDataServiceFolders 响应中的 FolderPagingResult.Folders[].FolderId 获取
parameters.name: folder_id

CreatedTime.description_en:
The creation time of the folder.

The format is `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ`. Example: `2020-09-24T18:37:51+0800`. The time zone offset in this example is `+0800`
CreatedTime.description_zh:
文件夹的创建时间。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ`，例如 `2020-09-24T18:37:51+0800`；该示例的时区偏移为 `+0800`

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the workflow to which the folder belongs
GroupId.description_zh: 文件夹所属业务流程的ID

ModifiedTime.description_en:
The modification time of the folder.

The format is `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ`. Example: `2020-09-24T18:37:51+0800`. The time zone offset in this example is `+0800`
ModifiedTime.description_zh:
文件夹的编辑时间。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ`，例如 `2020-09-24T18:37:51+0800`；该示例的时区偏移为 `+0800`

ParentId.description_en: The parent folder ID. The ID of the root folder under a workflow is 0, and the ID of a user-created folder is greater than 0
ParentId.description_zh: 父文件夹ID。业务流程下根文件夹ID等于0，用户创建文件夹ID大于0

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，一次请求的唯一标识
